sSQLCommandDte.defaultValue: select ac.quote_date,  ac.SRCE_CCY, ac.CNVRT_TO, case when FX_CLOSE_QUOTE is null then BO_CLOSE_QUOTE else FX_CLOSE_QUOTE end as CLOSE_QUOTE from (select q.quote_date, SUBSTR(q.quote_name,  4, 3) as SRCE_CCY, SUBSTR(q.quote_name, 8, 3) as CNVRT_TO from CAlypsodba.quote_value q where upper(q.quote_set_name) In ('FX','BACKOFFICE') and SUBSTR(q.quote_name, 1, 3) = 'FX.' and q.CLOSE_QUOTE <> 0 and SUBSTR(q.quote_name, 8, 3) = 'USD' and SUBSTR(q.quote_name, 4, 3) in ('EUR','AUD','NZD','GBP') and length(q.quote_name) = 10 and q.quote_date = trunc(to_date('10/8/2015', 'mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS')) group by q.quote_date, SUBSTR(q.quote_name, 4, 3), SUBSTR(q.quote_name,  8, 3) ) ac left join (select q1.quote_date,  SUBSTR(q1.quote_name,  4, 3) as SRCE_CCY1, SUBSTR(q1.quote_name, 8, 3) as CNVRT_TO1, q1.CLOSE_QUOTE as BO_CLOSE_QUOTE from CAlypsodba.quote_value q1 where upper(q1.quote_set_name) In ('BACKOFFICE') and SUBSTR(q1.quote_name,  1, 3) = 'FX.' and q1.CLOSE_QUOTE <> 0 and SUBSTR(q1.quote_name,  8, 3) = 'USD' and SUBSTR(q1.quote_name,  4, 3) in ('EUR','AUD','NZD','GBP') and length(q1.quote_name) = 10 and q1.quote_date = trunc(to_date('10/8/2015', 'mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS'))) ac2 on ac.quote_date = ac2.quote_date and ac.SRCE_CCY = ac2.SRCE_CCY1 and ac.CNVRT_TO = ac2.CNVRT_TO1 left join (select q2.quote_date,  SUBSTR(q2.quote_name,  4, 3) as SRCE_CCY2, SUBSTR(q2.quote_name,  8, 3) as CNVRT_TO2, q2.CLOSE_QUOTE as FX_CLOSE_QUOTE from CAlypsodba.quote_value q2 where upper(q2.quote_set_name) In ('FX') and SUBSTR(q2.quote_name,  1, 3) = 'FX.' and q2.CLOSE_QUOTE <> 0 and SUBSTR(q2.quote_name,  8, 3) = 'USD' and SUBSTR(q2.quote_name,  4, 3) in ('EUR','AUD','NZD','GBP') and length(q2.quote_name) = 10 and q2.quote_date = trunc(to_date('10/8/2015', 'mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS'))) ac3 on ac3.quote_date = ac.quote_date and ac3.SRCE_CCY2 = ac.SRCE_CCY and ac3.CNVRT_TO2 = ac.CNVRT_TO
